He went to the counter, to the display, and there is always this book. He has had it for like six weeks. The Shadow of the Wind. It is just sitting there, always. He picks it up, same weight, dog-eared, and usually he just puts it in the returns box because he thought somebody brings the books and puts them in the drop box. But now he feels it is warm.
